name: cinema-bergamo
description: Programmazione unificata dei cinema di Bergamo (UCI Orio, Arcadia Stezzano, Notorious Curno)

scripts.build: npm -w web run build && npm -w server run build
scripts.build:static: npm -w server run build && node scripts/snapshot.mjs && npm -w web run build:static
scripts.snapshot: npm -w server run build && node scripts/snapshot.mjs
scripts.typecheck: npm -w server run typecheck && npm -w web run check
